 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Coliseum hosts a clash of contrasting styles tonight on matchday three of the Conference League, as José Bordalás's Getafe urgently seek their first European win after taking just one point from a possible six and suffering a heavy blow against Lugano.
 They face a Brighton side who, despite arriving unbeaten with four points, are under pressure to claim all three to cement their place in the coveted top eight after stumbling to a goalless draw in their last away outing.
